summary.text: Austen Schauer is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 13 since December 1, 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Schauer was first elected to the North Dakota House of Representatives in the November 2018 general election for District 13, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as the House Industry, Business and Labor Committee and the House Government and Veterans Affairs Committee, which he chaired.
